name: Molten Frill
look: an upright crested theropod with a crimson gaping head, a huge glowing orange neck frill edged in flame, a cream body with crimson flame stripes and a long tail under a crest of fire
entry: A Pokémon resembling Moltres, pictured in an occult magazine's story of a lizard that hunted on the slopes of a volcano. It flares its frill to blaze like a bonfire, dazzling prey before it strikes.
how: Wild: very rare in volcanic biomes and badlands, and in the Nether's basalt deltas.
